title: Evaluation of the first parity layer
statement: Let $n,r,q$ be natural numbers, let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and choose an index $i$ in a layer of size $r^q2^r$. The AND gate applied to the parity-block minterm at index $i$ evaluates to the corresponding bottom-layer value at $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
$i$ is an index in a layer of size $r^q2^r$
